translationRepairs: In the eighth month of autumn Zhu Yougui sent Han Gong, Kang Huaiying, and Niu Cunjie with fifty thousand men in a furious siege of Hezhong.
In the eighth month of autumn Zhu Yougui sent Han Qing, Kang Huaiying, and Niu Cunjie with fifty thousand men in a furious siege of Hezhong.
The chapter's 韓、 is a damaged or truncated reading. Parallel passages identify Zhu Yougui's general as Han Qing (韓勍), so neither invented 'Han Gong' nor the bare surname is adequate.
That same day eleven Yan officers led by Situ Quanshuang defected with their families.
That same day eleven Yan officers led by Si Quanshuang defected with their families.
司 is the surname Si; it is not the compound surname 司徒.
Yang Shihou held the east bank of the Zhang; Cunxu camped at Zhanggong Bridge until staff officer Cao Jinjing went over to Liang; the Jin host faltered and pulled back.
Yang Shihou held the east bank of the Zhang; Cunxu camped at Zhanggong Bridge until staff officer Cao Jinjin went over to Liang; the Jin host faltered and pulled back.
曹進金 romanizes as Cao Jinjin, not Cao Jinjing.

Yang Shihou had just died at Weizhou; the Liang Founder split Xiang, Wei, and Chan into a separate circuit, made Delun commissioner of Weibo and Zhang Jun commissioner of Xiang, and the Wei troops refused to submit.

Yang Shihou had just died at Weizhou; the Liang ruler split Xiang, Wei, and Chan into a separate circuit, made Delun commissioner of Weibo and Zhang Jun commissioner of Xiang, and the Wei troops refused to submit.
After Zhu Yougui's death, 梁主 denotes the reigning Later Liang ruler Zhu Youzhen, not the dynasty's founder.
That month the Liang Founder sent Wang Tan with fifty thousand from Yindi Pass to storm Taiyuan; Li Sizhao sent Shi Jiacai with three hundred horse.
That month the Liang ruler sent Wang Tan with fifty thousand from Yindi Pass to storm Taiyuan; Li Sizhao sent Shi Jiacai with three hundred horse.
梁主 again denotes the current Later Liang ruler; the Founder had already been murdered in s0031.
